welcome.title: TIKETI - Ticketing Management
welcome.login_prompt: Please enter your credentials to access the system.

tenant.instant_sync: Instant synchronization between all your stations.

hero.description: From counter sales to boarding checks, manage your routes, connections and every seat in real time. A single platform to streamline travel and secure your revenue.

features.title: Features designed for you
features.description: In a constantly evolving sector, TIKETI gives you a head start. No more revenue losses, overwhelmed sellers or lack of visibility.

ticketing_items.seat_map_text: View your bus occupancy at a glance.

admin_items.dashboard_text: Real-time view of revenue and sales volume.
admin_items.accounting_text: Cash drawer closing reports by seller.

control_items.scan_text: check the ticket and detect duplicates.
control_items.offline_text: keep checking tickets, then sync when reconnected.

connections.title: Connections, finally easy to operate
connections.description: Sell a combined trip with a vehicle change on a single ticket. TIKETI follows the passenger to their final destination and gives each station the right information at the right time.
connections.item1_text: View expected passengers by station, their status and final destination.
connections.item2_text: Automatically assign the best available seat or stay in control with manual mode.
connections.item3_text: The transit agent marks the passenger as ready before placing them on the connecting trip.
connections.item4_text: Availability is checked per segment to prevent any double booking.
connections.step1_text: Final destination and transfer station recorded.
connections.step2_text: The passenger is ready for their connection.
connections.step3_text: The second vehicle's manifest is updated.

control.title: Tiketi Control secures every boarding
control.description: Give controllers, drivers and supervisors useful tools in the field. The app stays fast, readable and operational even when the network becomes unstable.
control.scan_text: Validate the QR code, trip, seat and ticket status in seconds.
control.manifest_text: View passengers, connections and confirm every boarding.
control.offline_text: Work on a reliable cache; actions are reconciled and synced once the network returns.
control.field_text: Today's trips, seat map, team messages and incident tracking all in one place.

roles.title: A Solution for Every Stakeholder
roles.description: TIKETI structures your company by clearly defining responsibilities.
roles.admin_text: Creates routes, sets prices, manages roles and analyzes overall profitability.
roles.supervisor_text: Field management, ticket control and supervision of counter sales.
roles.seller_text: Ultra-fast sales interface. Real-time seat assignment.
roles.executive_text: Audit and consolidated view: access to detailed and consolidated financial reports.

loyalty.title: Build Passenger Loyalty
loyalty.description: Thanks to native integration with the **OKOHI** ecosystem, offer your passengers a modern, 100% digital loyalty experience.
loyalty.qr_text: A quick scan with every purchase to earn points instantly.
loyalty.rewards_text: After 10 trips, unlock discounts or free rides that you configure.
loyalty.retention_text: Identify your most regular customers and adapt your offers.

why.title: Why TIKETI?
why.description: Maximize your profits and modernize your brand image with a robust solution.

benefits.real_time_text: No more double sales. When a ticket is sold at station A, the seat is instantly blocked for station B.
benefits.revenue_text: Thanks to our smart segment system, a released seat immediately becomes available again for the rest of the trip.
benefits.control_text: Track every penny. From detailed financial reports to instant cash audits, you have eyes on everything.

contact.title: Ready to modernize your fleet?
contact.description: Leave us a message and our team of experts will contact you for a personalized demo.

footer.description: The complete solution for managing your ticketing and transport fleet.
